title: The Motes Beneath the Bridge
opening: Evening settles over Hemlock Village. Blue motes gather beneath the old bridge, where the wood gives a low, familiar creak.
prompt_message: The motes drift against the wind and collect around the southern rail.

choices.label: Call the party closer and watch

success.shared_text: The motes tighten into a luminous trail beneath the bridge. For one breath, the forest seems to listen.
success.private_text: A whisper reaches Renn alone: “Do not trust the lantern keeper.”
success.journal: Blue motes gathered beneath the southern bridge and formed a trail. A private warning named the lantern keeper.

failure.shared_text: The motes flare and scatter into the trees. The bridge settles into silence before their pattern becomes clear.
failure.private_text: Renn cannot yet determine what drew the motes to the bridge.
failure.journal: Blue motes gathered beneath the southern bridge, then scattered before their pattern could be understood.
